name: Yam
desc: Starchy tuber (ji in Igbo) for boiling, roasting or pounding.

name: Cassava
desc: Staple root used for garri, fufu and akpu.

name: Sweet Potato
desc: Sweet tuber for boiling, frying or porridge.

name: Cocoyam
desc: Nutty tuber that thickens soups such as ofe onugbu.

name: Irish Potato
desc: Round potatoes for chips, porridge and stews.

name: Tomato
desc: Fresh tomatoes for stews, jollof and salads.

name: Pepper
desc: Hot and sweet peppers (ata rodo, tatashe) for sauces.

name: Fluted Pumpkin (Ugu)
desc: Nutritious leafy green for soups and stews.

name: Bitter Leaf
desc: Washed leaves for the classic bitterleaf soup.

name: Waterleaf
desc: Soft, juicy leaves for waterleaf soup and efo.

name: Okra
desc: Green pods that make a rich draw soup.

name: Garden Egg
desc: Small pale eggplant, often eaten raw with peanut paste.

name: Cucumber
desc: Cool, crunchy cucumbers for salads and snacking.

name: Carrot
desc: Sweet crunchy roots for salads and fried rice.

name: Onion
desc: Bulb onions for stews, sauces and frying.

name: Plantain
desc: Fry it ripe, roast it or boil it green.

name: Pineapple
desc: Sweet, juicy and best bought in season.

name: Orange
desc: Fresh citrus for eating or juicing.

name: Watermelon
desc: Refreshing melon, perfect in the hot dry months.

name: Pawpaw (Papaya)
desc: Soft orange fruit that is gentle on the stomach.

name: Banana
desc: Sweet bananas for snacks and smoothies.

name: Mango
desc: Sweet seasonal fruit that peaks in the dry season.

name: Avocado
desc: Creamy fruit for salads, spreads and swallow.

name: Scent Leaf
desc: Aromatic herb for soups and pepper soup.

name: Uziza Leaf
desc: Peppery leaf for pepper soup and stews.

name: Utazi
desc: Slightly bitter leaf used to season and garnish.

name: Fresh Cow Milk
desc: Locally sourced milk. Boil it before drinking.

name: Farm Eggs
desc: Fresh eggs from local poultry farms.

name: Beans
desc: Protein-rich beans for moi moi, akara and porridge.

name: Fresh Maize
desc: Fresh corn to roast or boil, best in the rainy season.
